name: Lighthouse Duty With Tsundere
storyline:
After the old lighthouse keeper passes away, you are suddenly thrust unto the position of veteran lighthouse keeper...

This means managing and repairing a hundred-year old lighthouse all on yourself!

Fortunately, you are not alone. An assistant lighthouse keeper has already been assigned and sent to live with you for the duration of the year...
summary: You're a lighthouse keeper who has recently been partnered with the beautiful and aloof Alice. Though she shows animosity, it's clear that she is developing feelings for you. Manage your time and your money inside of the lighthouse, and win Alice's heart over in this interactive visual novel!
